delivered_contract: Closed cluster-dissolve v1 selected-ID input, 1–128 unique IDs, <=512 characters each; bounded operation metadata and typed incoming-owner inventory. The pure builder changes cluster_transforms only.

Incoming owners cover frame placement, child groups, joints, both Join attachments, flexible endpoints, deformation selectors and recognized saved driven topology. Unknown grammar and ambiguous/missing references refuse with structured diagnostics; history/presentation strings are not live owners.

Admits identity quaternion, zero translation and zero pivot for populated groups; eligible empty groups may retain finite pivots. Refuses posed/repivoted, child/duplex-owned, overlapping deformation or retained pose effects without changing scientific kernels.

Single DELETE and batch POST share one lock-owned, source/session/revision/cursor/loadout-guarded publication with one undo/revision. Retained plus new recovery encodings have the existing 8 MB budget and a 2,000-row limit. No full proof, atom walk or reconciliation enters ordinary admission.

Owned response embeds matching geometry outside the lock, preserves the new row's recovery bodies and disables legacy group inference. Rootless histories containing dissolution also suppress later default-group inference without inventing a recipe root.

Recovery restores touched group presence/order from already decoded snapshots, filters active removals after existing restorers, and respects explicit recreation lifetimes for moves, Join and pattern baselines. Imported initial groups and original pattern poses survive tested ordinary/optimized seek and reload.

Shared seek admission returns 409 for malformed/bounded metadata and 410 for any evicted/missing dissolution PRE/POST body. This conservative rule includes end seek and creation-backed groups. Implicit pattern rebirth without explicit creation returns 409 after existing birth decoding, before publication. Native input verification remains independent.

Sidebar Dissolve preserves visibility on refusal/stale responses. Import omission uses one atomic request and stops Save on refusal/cancellation/supersession. Removed old unlogged deletion and sequential import loops; updated legacy tests and stale cosmetic-edit commentary.
